Lord '''Aedmun Matherin''' is a lord of a minor [[house]] in [[Andor]].

==History==
Lord Aedmun is the current [[High Seat]] of [[House Matherin]]. His grandmother was [[Nelein Matherin]].

==Activities==
Lord Aedmun learns of the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|succession]] in [[Caemlyn]]. He and his armsmen go to the capital to support [[Elayne Trakand]].{{ref/book|10|10}}
